title.narrative: African Climate Summit II: Africa for Global Impact

description.narrative: The second Africa Climate Summit (ACS2) aims to convene African leaders, investors, and global stakeholders to strengthen African unity and climate leadership, particularly in the lead-up to COP30. A central objective is to reframe Africa's global role from being seen primarily as a victim of climate change to take active global leadership and becoming a part of the solution. The summit will further promote nature-based and endogenous solutions, mobilize climate finance and green investments, accelerate energy access, and foster global partnerships and structural reforms. Ethiopia will host the summit together with the African Union. Ethiopia is politically very committed to the green transition and to positioning itself internationally. Furthermore, AU has in recent years stepped onto the international climate stage with high ambitions and an increasing engagement. The African Climate Summit is a result of this. ASC2 provides a crucial platform for political leaders and other stakeholders of Africa to discuss the green transition and shape a common African climate position ahead of COP30. Denmark can help ensure a successful summit while also strengthening its partnership with Ethiopia and the African Union, with whom we share many mutual interests regarding the green transition. The event is scheduled to take place from 8th-10th September 2025.
